title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Only one position
hook: A player only wants to play catcher.
intro: They do not want to try anywhere else.
statement: Kids pick positions where they feel safe.
q1: Do you let them stay where they are happy —
q2: or ask them to try other positions too?
q3: What makes that position feel safe?
t1: Every kid is different. But players grow
t2: when they try new spots with support.
cta: Coaches — how do you handle it?
ctaLines: Half and half. Let them stay. A new spot in practice.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A player only wants to play catcher.
They ask every game. They do not want to try anywhere else.
Kids pick positions where they feel safe.
Let them stay or ask them to try new spots. There is no single right way.
How do you handle it? Share your habit in the comments.
